event_data.context: Filesystem journal and replica reconciliation merged in PRs #4 and #5. SQLite PR #6 revision f1aaf0f verifies effective journal modes, handles supplied connection count rows, validates a bounded bit-length payload format, and adds bundled SQLite to CI. All 37 local tests pass on SQLCipher and bundled SQLite. PostgreSQL and command snapshots remain in progress; real PostgreSQL and snapshot prototypes passed in isolation.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the durable storage and command state capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Durable storage and command state
